Zelensky:
We need a big, strong army for a minimum of 10 years.
It is very expensive, but our country has been destroyed by massive attacks and our economy cannot function at 100% during wartime.
We need time for reconstruction and investment. That's why we need financial support from our partners.

Zelensky:
Russia produces 140 ballistic missiles every month, and they already have 700 ballistic missiles in storage.
Everybody talks about these missiles, but you can solve this problem.
About 70% of the components in each ballistic missile come from other countries — Asia, the United States and Europe.
You can stop it because these are your companies. Worldwide companies are selling these components to Russia.

Zelensky:
We told our American partners: Switch on Starlink in those parts of Russia where they launch ballistic missiles.
Why must we all be under attack? Why must all of Europe be afraid that Russian ballistic missiles will reach European territory?
Switch on Starlink. We will do it. We will handle it.
Of course, we will do it if Russia doesn't stop this war.
Switch it on. It's not difficult, really.

NEW: China’s Moonshot AI has launched Kimi K3.1 Pro, an upgraded version of its 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 model that it says rivals top U.S. systems on coding and agent tasks. 
On the Terminal-Bench 4.0 agentic coding benchmark, Moonshot reports a score of 65.7%, ahead of OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra at 58.2% and just behind Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 at 66.4%,.
Independent evaluator Artificial Analysis measured it at 67%, the highest of any model it tested. 
API pricing is set at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, a third lower than its predecessor and well below leading closed models. 
Moonshot said it removed cyber-related training data from the open-weight release to limit misuse.

Zelensky:
You can't just impose sanctions and then lift them because winter is difficult.
You sanction oil but not gas, natural gas but not LNG, petrol but not diesel.
Then you sanction diesel and lift the sanctions. You sanction chemicals, then say it's difficult for farmers without fertilizers.
You freeze assets, then lift sanctions on parts of the banking system.

Zelensky:
During this year of war, we have received dozens, perhaps a few hundred, missiles to defend our skies.
Middle Eastern countries used about 2,000 in the first 48 hours of the war.
That doesn't mean we shouldn't support Middle Eastern allies. Of course we should support them, help them and defend them.
But everything has to be competitive.

Zelensky:
Sanctions work, but total sanctions.
If you impose them, please don't lift them.
You speak about frozen assets, but there are other countries where Russia can still use its money.

The United States is rushing to move some diplomats and their families out of several Middle Eastern countries amid fears of a regional escalation.
State Department this week ordered non-emergency staff and all family members to leave Saudi Arabia following increased Houthi attacks on the kingdom, while quietly reducing staff at embassies in Jordan, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, the UAE and Lebanon without public announcements. 
Many of those leaving had only recently returned after being ordered out at the height of the Iran war, with one diplomat saying “to say it has been chaotic is an understatement” and a source in Amman describing a “very Groundhog Day vibe.” 
Source: CNN
